Secca was a [[Nomai]] from [[the Vessel]]. When the Vessel crashed on [[Dark Bramble]], they were in [[Escape Pod 3]] alongside [[Escall]], [[Din]], and several other Nomai. 

==Escape Pod 3==
Escape Pod 3 crashed inside Dark Bramble, which destroyed its communication and navigation capabilities.<ref>SECCA: Our escape pod crashed as we tried to flee this place, destroying our movement and communication capabilities in the process.</ref> Secca left a recording where they explained that since their supply of air was nearly depleted and the [[Anglerfish]] attacks came more and more frequently, they would return to the Vessel to either repair the damage or await rescue.<ref>SECCA: We’ve held out as long as we could here, but this pod’s supply of breathable air is nearly depleted, and the anglerfish attack more and more frequently. SECCA: Our best chance at survival is to return to the Vessel to either repair the damage or, more probably, await rescue.</ref>

After Din detected duplicate signals coming from the Vessel, Secca thought it was not possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations.<ref>DIN: There is a new problem: Our equipment is detecting two distinct beacons from the Vessel. SECCA: But it isn’t possible for the Vessel to be in two different locations at the same time.</ref> They also stressed that they were running out of time as the Vessel's beacon was fading.<ref>DIN: I agree, but the beacons are exactly identical to each other. Perhaps if I had more time — SECCA: We’re nearly out of time already, Din; the Vessel’s beacon is quickly fading. Soon, it will be gone, and we will be lost.</ref> Escall decided that they should go to the beacon whose source was closest to them.<ref>ESCALL: We will follow the beacon whose source is nearest to us.</ref>

==Fate==
However, this signal led to a bramble seed, which was too small to fit in.<ref>SECCA: It's almost too faint to hear now, but the Vessel's beacon is still faintly emitting from within this thorny seed. Yet the opening is too small for even a single Nomai to fit through it, so our escape pod couldn't have flown through here.</ref> Secca noted that Dark Bramble seems to manipulate space itself, and how it was hard for them to be this close to the location of the Vessel, but unable to reach it.<ref>SECCA: I don’t understand how this could be possible, but this gruesome place seems able to manipulate space itself; maybe this was our undoing. SECCA: To be so close to the location of the Vessel and still so far is... difficult. Worse, the Vessel’s beacon is dying; soon, we will be unable to hear it.</ref> They hoped that perhaps they could still find a way inside, or at least understand why this happened.<ref>SECCA: There is nothing we can do now but try to perhaps find a way inside, or at least attempt to comprehend why this happened.</ref> In Secca's last recording, they expressed their hope that other escape pods had reached relative safety.<ref>SECCA: My dearest hope is that the other escape pods were able to reach relative safety.</ref> Unfortunately, due to the lack of oxygen, Secca perished near the bramble seed with the rest of Escape Pod 3.
